0.headline: 11 IPOs worth Rs 7,055 crore to hit D-Street next week; Rentomojo, Karamtara among key issues
0.heading: 11 IPOs worth Rs 7,055 crore to hit D-Street next week; Rentomojo, Karamtara among key issues
0.intro: The IPOs are scheduled to hit the market between September 7 and September 15, with most of the issues opening for subscription on Tuesday and Wednesday
0.body:
India's primary market is bracing for another packed week, with 11 main-board companies — including Rentomojo, Karamtara Engineering and Kanohar Electricals — set to raise Rs 7,055 crore through initial public offerings (IPOs).

The IPOs are scheduled to open between September 7 and September 15, with most issues launching for subscription on Tuesday and Wednesday.

"This multi-issue rush reflects an eagerness to lock in early-stage growth equity in young companies as all these companies are below USD 1 billion market cap at listing," said Rajkumar Rathi, Chief Investment Officer at YES Securities.

The companies heading to the primary market span real estate development, engineering and manufacturing, payments and identity solutions, specialty chemicals, and online rental services.

Of the total Rs 7,055 crore, Rs 2,722 crore (39 per cent) constitutes primary capital issuance, where proceeds go directly to the companies, while Rs 4,333 crore (61 per cent) represents a secondary sale by existing shareholders. This split, Rathi noted, reflects strong corporate confidence and ample liquidity within India's primary market.

Proceeds from the fresh issues will primarily be used for business expansion, capital expenditure, debt repayment, working capital needs and other general corporate purposes.

The upcoming wave of IPOs follows an already active start to September, with Rays of Belief and Deepa Jewellers launching their issues on September 1. With this latest batch, the total number of companies launching IPOs in 2026 is expected to climb to 75 — which includes 23 issues launched in August.

Among the 11 companies, Pranav Constructions will be the first to open for public subscription on September 7. The issue, worth over Rs 351 crore, will close on September 9.

It will be followed by Kanohar Electricals, Prasol Chemicals and Glass Wall Systems (India), which open their IPOs on September 8. Rentomojo, Manipal Payment and Identity Solutions, Arcil, LCC Projects, Karamtara Engineering and Steamhouse India will launch their issues on September 9, while Veegaland Developers will open its IPO on September 10.

Pranav Constructions has set a price band of Rs 118-124 per share, comprising a fresh issue worth Rs 315.6 crore and an offer-for-sale (OFS) of 28.57 lakh shares valued at Rs 35.43 crore.

Kanohar Electricals has fixed a price band of Rs 601-632 per share for its Rs 1,056-crore issue.

Prasol Chemicals' price band stands at Rs 643-676 per share for its Rs 500-crore IPO, comprising a fresh issue of Rs 80 crore and an OFS of up to Rs 420 crore.

Glass Wall Systems (India) has set a price band of Rs 172-182 per share for its Rs 428-crore issue.

Rentomojo has fixed its price band at Rs 384-404 per equity share for a Rs 1,256-crore IPO, comprising a fresh issue worth up to Rs 150 crore and an OFS of 2.73 crore shares valued at Rs 1,106 crore at the upper price band.

Karamtara Engineering's Rs 875-crore IPO includes a fresh issue of Rs 675 crore and an OFS worth up to Rs 200 crore, with a price band of Rs 241-254 per share.

Manipal Payment and Identity Solutions has set a price band of Rs 322-339 per share for its Rs 805-crore issue, comprising a fresh issue of Rs 320 crore and an OFS of up to 1.43 crore shares worth Rs 485 crore.

Arcil's Rs 733-crore IPO, priced at Rs 132-139 per share, is entirely an OFS — meaning the company will not receive any proceeds from the offering.

LCC Projects has fixed a price band of Rs 139-146 per share for its Rs 427-crore issue.

Steamhouse India aims to raise Rs 414 crore through its IPO, comprising a fresh issue of Rs 353 crore and an OFS of Rs 61 crore.

Veegaland Developers will raise Rs 210 crore entirely through a fresh issue of shares, with its IPO opening on September 10 and closing on September 15.

With PTI inputs

1.headline: Info Edge-backed Meritto's parent NoPaperForms Solutions files updated DRHP to raise Rs 375 crore in fresh capital via IPO
1.heading: Info Edge-backed Meritto's parent NoPaperForms Solutions files updated DRHP to raise Rs 375 crore in fresh capital via IPO
1.intro: NoPaperForms Solutions IPO | The company has proposed to raise Rs 375 crore through the issuance of fresh equity shares, alongside an offer for sale of 3.84 crore equity shares by investor Startup Investments (Holding).
1.body:
Gurugram-headquartered education-focused technology platform NoPaperForms Solutions, which is backed by Info Edge (India), has filed its updated draft red herring prospectus (DRHP) with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) to raise capital through an IPO.

The AI-powered education SaaS provider has proposed to raise Rs 375 crore through the issuance of fresh equity shares, alongside an offer for sale (OFS) of 3.84 crore equity shares by investor Startup Investments (Holding).

Info Edge-owned Startup Investments (Holding) held 47.93 percent of the company’s pre-offer paid-up equity capital at the time of filing the updated DRHP on September 4.

The company is also considering raising up to Rs 75 crore through a pre-IPO placement, prior to the filing of the red herring prospectus. If the pre-IPO placement is undertaken, the amount raised will be deducted from the fresh issue component.

NoPaperForms Solutions, which develops software-as-a-service (SaaS), embedded payments and agentic AI products for the education industry, had approached the capital markets by filing its draft offer document through the confidential pre-filing route in November 2025. The document was subsequently approved by SEBI in March 2026.

The company claims to be India’s largest platform in the student enrolment and payments segment, operating through two flagship products, Meritto and Collexo, along with extended offerings such as the student engagement suite Pixi and Mio AI, which cater to various types of educational organisations.

Click Here To Read All IPO News

Promoted by Naveen Goyal, NoPaperForms Solutions will utilise Rs 96 crore of the net fresh issue proceeds for customer acquisition and retention, while Rs 148 crore will be used for technology development and cloud infrastructure. The remaining proceeds will be allocated towards general corporate purposes and funding inorganic growth through unidentified acquisitions.

The company addresses student acquisition, enrolment, fee management and student engagement processes through its education platform. It derived 91 percent of its revenue from domestic operations in FY26, while its international business contributed around 9 percent.

Profit for the year ended March 2026 surged more than six-fold to Rs 11.9 crore from Rs 1.88 crore in the previous year, while revenue for the same period grew 25.2 percent to Rs 115.6 crore from Rs 92.3 crore. In the latest quarter ended June 2026, the company reported a profit of Rs 6 crore and revenue of Rs 44.7 crore.

IIFL Capital Services and SBI Capital Markets are the merchant bankers managing the NoPaperForms Solutions IPO.

2.headline: Plastic products maker Manika Plastech's IPO to open on September 11; company to raise Rs 92.5 crore
2.heading: Plastic products maker Manika Plastech's IPO to open on September 11; company to raise Rs 92.5 crore
2.intro: Manika Plastech IPO | The company aims to raise Rs 92.5 crore through the issuance of fresh equity shares, while promoter entity VRIDAA Holding Trust Hitech Corporation will offload up to 76.74 lakh shares through an offer for sale.
2.body:
Mumbai-headquartered plastic products manufacturer Manika Plastech has tapped the capital markets, opening its maiden public issue for subscription on September 11.

The company aims to raise Rs 92.5 crore through a fresh issue of equity shares, while promoter entity VRIDAA Holding Trust Hitech Corporation will offload up to 76.74 lakh shares through an offer for sale (OFS).

The anchor book will open for a day for institutional investors on September 10, while the public can participate in the offer until September 16. The company is likely to finalise the IPO share allotment by September 17, with trading in its equity shares expected to commence on the bourses from September 21.

Manika Plastech has reduced the size of its public issue across both components. As per the draft offer document filed in June 2025, the company had planned to raise Rs 115 crore through a fresh issue, alongside an OFS of 1.5 crore equity shares by the promoter. The draft papers were subsequently approved by SEBI in October 2025.

Promoted by the Kapadia family, Manika Plastech is a design-led, precision-engineered rigid polymer packaging company that manufactures standardised as well as customised battery casings, pails and containers, automotive components and thin-wall containers.

The company operates seven manufacturing facilities with a total capacity of 29,200 MTPA. Its products are used across several industries, including vehicle batteries, inverters, paints, agrochemicals, lubricants, food and dairy products, and construction chemicals.

Click Here To Read All IPO News

The company, which competes with listed peers such as Mold-Tek Packaging, Shaily Engineering Plastics and Hitech Corporation, intends to use Rs 54.9 crore of the net fresh issue proceeds to purchase plant and machinery.

A further Rs 15 crore will be used to repay debt, against total outstanding borrowings of Rs 77.9 crore as of July 2026. The remaining proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.

In the latest quarter ended June 2026, Manika Plastech reported a profit of Rs 13 crore and revenue of Rs 162.4 crore.

For the fiscal year ended March 2026, its profit grew 15.9 percent to Rs 22.4 crore, while revenue from operations increased 7.3 percent year-on-year to Rs 436 crore.

Pantomath Capital Advisors has been appointed as the merchant banker for managing the Manika Plastech IPO.
